### 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

### 💡 Problem or Opportunity
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
*Example: "I want to run 6 instances simultaneously with unique static IPv6 addresses and automated window tiling..."*

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working. Include architecture ideas, UI mockups, or API designs if applicable.

### 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've evaluated.

### 🌟 Domain Area
- [ ] Hardware Virtualization (WHPX / CPU / GPU Vulkan)
- [ ] Network Bridging (TAP / NDIS / DHCP / Multi-IP)
- [ ] Physical Phone Mirroring & USB Input Injection
- [ ] Wireless Companion & Android TV Receiver Mode
- [ ] Multi-Instance Orchestration & Docking
- [ ] Package Installer & Tooling
- [ ] Other

### 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, or references here.
